query:
SELECT action, details, adminName, createdAt 
FROM adminActivityLog 
WHERE action LIKE '%swap%' OR action LIKE '%session%' OR action LIKE '%conflict%' OR details LIKE '%swap%' OR details LIKE '%session%' OR details LIKE '%Binks%' OR details LIKE '%Wijeratne%' OR details LIKE '%Hackett%' OR details LIKE '%Kunaseelan%' OR details LIKE '%Monahan%' OR details LIKE '%Bousfield%' OR details LIKE '%Anderson%'
ORDER BY createdAt ASC;
